one_time_products.title: Remove Ads
one_time_products.description: Permanently removes all banner and interstitial ads. Rewarded ads remain available so you can still earn free coins and lives.

one_time_products.title: 100 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 100 coins to your wallet. Spend coins on hints, extra moves, and unlocking new themes.

one_time_products.title: 500 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 500 coins to your wallet. Best value coin pack — spend on hints, extra moves, and unlocking new themes.

one_time_products.title: 5 Lives
one_time_products.description: Instantly refills your hearts to the maximum so you can keep playing without waiting for them to recharge.

one_time_products.title: 1hr Unlimited
one_time_products.description: Play with unlimited lives for one full hour. Perfect for a long puzzle session without any interruption.

one_time_products.title: Unlimited Lives
one_time_products.description: Never run out of lives again. Play as many levels as you want, whenever you want, with no waiting.

one_time_products.title: Undo Pack (10)
one_time_products.description: Adds 10 undos to your account. Take back any move at any time so one mistake never costs you a level.

one_time_products.title: Starter Pack
one_time_products.description: Best value for new players: 100 coins, 5 hints, and 5 lives bundled together. One-time purchase.

subscriptions.title: Season Pass
subscriptions.description: Monthly pass: ad-free play, +50 daily coins, exclusive themes, and unlimited hints. Cancel anytime in Google Play.
